career_ladder.note: Yantriks are the technical warrant sailor cadre in the Indian Coast Guard holding diplomas in Mechanical, Electrical, or Electronics & Telecommunication engineering. Personnel maintain ship propulsion plants, power generators, radar electronics, and shipboard armaments, advancing through senior technical grades up to Pradhan Sahayak Engineer (Level 10).

steps.years: Entry rank (basic training at INS Chilka + technical training at naval schools)
steps.source_label: Indian Coast Guard — CGEPT 02/2024 Notification for Yantrik (Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics)
7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Coast Guard Technical Ratings)

exam_scheme.note: Yantrik recruitment through CGEPT requires passing Stage-I Online CBT consisting of Section I (Common Class 10 syllabus) plus the candidate's engineering discipline section (Section III for Mechanical, Section IV for Electrical, or Section V for Electronics). This is followed by Stage-II PFT and Document Verification, Stage-III Final Medicals at INS Chilka, and Stage-IV final onboarding.

stages.source_label: Indian Coast Guard — Scheme of Examination for Yantrik CGEPT 02/2024

papers.paper_name: Section I (Common Class 10 Syllabus): Maths (20), Science (10), English (15), Reasoning (10), GK (5)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 30 marks for UR/EWS/OBC; 27 marks for SC/ST

papers.paper_name: Section III (Diploma Mechanical) / Section IV (Diploma Electrical) / Section V (Diploma Electronics)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 20 marks for UR/EWS/OBC; 17 marks for SC/ST. Must pass Section I and engineering section separately.

financial_package.note: Yantriks in the Indian Coast Guard are placed in Pay Matrix Level 5 (₹29,200 – ₹92,300) under the 7th CPC. Additionally, personnel receive a specialized technical allowance known as Yantrik Pay of ₹6,200 per month plus applicable Dearness Allowance on Yantrik Pay, along with free ration, housing, and clothing concessions.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Indian Coast Guard — CGEPT 02/2024 Official Notification (Pay, Allowances and Concessions)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 5 entry basic pay of ₹29,200 plus fixed Yantrik Pay of ₹6,200 (combined base ₹35,400): Dearness Allowance @ 58% on basic + Yantrik Pay is ₹20,532; Ration Money Allowance is ~₹3,965; HRA spans 10% to 30% (₹2,920 to ₹8,760); Transport Allowance is ~₹2,133 to ₹5,688. Gross monthly salary ranges from ₹60,000 to ₹74,000. In-hand earnings after 10% NPS deduction (~₹4,973) are approximately ₹52,000 to ₹64,000.
official_perks: Yantrik Pay of ₹6,200 per month plus applicable DA on Yantrik Pay for all engineering diploma holders
Free ration / Messing allowance and service clothing according to naval scale
Free medical treatment for self and dependent family members through Armed Forces / Coast Guard Hospitals
Government residential accommodation in Coast Guard enclaves or central HRA
Annual leave of 45 days and casual leave of 8 days with LTC concessions
